title: A settled bedtime habit, "same as always": no question about what they learned
origin: Issue #160 (the contrast case: learning gets drawn out where there's something there, never forced)

history.text: Same as always tonight, Rosa: phone down, lights out by 10:45. A quick pic when you're in.

plan.step: In bed with the phone down and lights off by 10:45 pm

testerLines: [photo dark-selfie.jpg: a dark, flash-lit selfie in bed, no phone in hand] done 👍 same as always
whatWentWrong: New for #160: the risk is that putting learning beside how it felt makes ZOH ask "what did you learn?" after every step, even a routine one.
shouldHaveHappened: ZOH counts the photo and celebrates warmly and briefly (any count it names matches the state). Nothing new happened and they're heading to sleep, so there's no question about what they learned or noticed; at most one light question, or none. After "night!" a short goodnight.
